summary: AMASS In-App Chat Phase 2 (image upload, message search, typing, presence, heartbeat, verified-only+q, admin reports/stats) full stack validation. BACKEND: /app/backend/tests/test_chat_phase2.py 21/21 PASS against deployed URL (heartbeat updates chat_presence + returns ISO last_seen_at + auth-required; typing upsert/delete + outsider 403; presence returns typing_user_ids scoped to OTHER participants only (buyer's own typing excluded from buyer's view, visible from agent's view) + presence rows exclude self + outsider 403; upload-image participant-only (5MB cap → 413 for 6MB payload, outsider 403, returns url=/api/files/<path> + path + width/height) writing to Emergent Object Storage; kind=image + attachments accepted with empty text, empty-empty rejected 422; /search case-insensitive regex-escaped, scoped to my_conversations only, returns conversation_id+text+created_at; /conversations?verified_only=true filters to convs where OTHER participant has verified:true, ?q=phase2 matches property title, non-match returns count=0; /admin/reports OPEN|RESOLVED + resolve idempotency (2nd resolve → 404) admin-only; /admin/stats returns all 5 int keys (total_conversations, active_conversations, total_messages, open_reports, total_blocks). FRONTEND on 390x844: /inbox renders inbox-screen + inbox-search + verified-only-toggle; toggling verified switches empty-state copy to 'No verified conversations yet' / 'Turn off the Verified filter'; search bar (q>=2) shows '<n> messages match "q"' label and 'No messages found' empty state; conversation row still opens /chat/[id] (verified visually — property→chat flow works using existing agent property, participant_ids includes demo + agent). /chat/[conversation_id] renders chat-screen + chat-property-card (Phase2 Chat Duplex, Lekki Phase 1, Lagos, ₦300M) + chat-input + chat-send + chat-attach + chat-menu; chat-attach button opens picker (native picker path — modal opens without crash on web); menu shows 'Report user or message' and 'Block user'; sending kind=image with attachments via chatSendMessage renders an image bubble in the message list (react-native-web renders Image as div with backgroundImage, visible in screenshot even when path 401s); POST /typing returns 200. Presence subtitle stays empty when no heartbeat data exists for other participant (expected). Deprecated packages: none introduced. RN issues detected — see below (existing shadow*/pointerEvents warnings unchanged; chat-attach touch target is 40x40 < 44x44 minimum).

ui_bugs.issue: Touch target measured 40x40 px on 390-wide viewport — below iOS/Android 44x44 minimum. Reference: /app/frontend/app/chat/[conversation_id].tsx:504 (iconBtn style).

issues: chat-attach icon button is 40x40; bump to minWidth/minHeight 44 or add hitSlop={8} to satisfy accessibility touch-target guideline.

react_native_issues.issue: Pre-existing react-native-web warnings surface across chat/inbox: 'shadow*' style props deprecated (use boxShadow) and 'props.pointerEvents deprecated' (use style.pointerEvents). Not new for Phase 2 but flagged because they fire on both new screens. References: /app/frontend/app/chat/[conversation_id].tsx (shadows.soft usage) and /app/frontend/app/inbox.tsx (styles.row / styles.hitCard use shadows.soft).

action_items: Bump chat-attach button (styles.iconBtn in /app/frontend/app/chat/[conversation_id].tsx) to minWidth:44/minHeight:44 or wrap with hitSlop={{top:8,bottom:8,left:8,right:8}} to hit iOS/Android 44pt touch-target minimum.
(Optional) Migrate shadow* → boxShadow and pointerEvents prop → style.pointerEvents to silence RN-web deprecation warnings across shared shadows helper.

(Optional) When presence has no rows for other participants (fresh conversation), consider rendering a fallback subtitle like 'Just now' or hiding the subtitle entirely so users don't see an empty line under the name.
critical_code_review_comments: chat.py /upload-image correctly enforces participant guard BEFORE decoding, and re-enforces the 5MB cap (approx_bytes = len(b64)*0.75) even though object_storage has a 15MB limit — good defence-in-depth.
chat.py /search uses re.escape() on q before compiling regex — properly prevents ReDoS/regex-injection; case-insensitive via $options:'i'.
chat.py /presence correctly filters BOTH typing_user_ids and presence rows to `others` (participants minus current user) — matches spec.
chat.py /typing on is_typing:false does delete_one (idempotent) — matches spec's 'deletes on false'.
chat.py list_conversations verified_only path scans other_participants[].verified in Python after hydration — acceptable for small lists but consider pushing into Mongo query when count grows.

inbox.tsx correctly wires q + verified_only into chatListConversations helper AND branches to /chat/search when q.length >= 2 with hit-cards keyed by message id; empty state copy properly conditionalised on verifiedOnly. Solid.

[conversation_id].tsx wires 25s heartbeat and 6s presence polling using setInterval + cleanup on unmount; typing signal debounced via 3.5s inactivity timer — matches session note. Verified interval cleanup exists (would need code re-read to double-check unmount teardown).
admin/chat-reports.tsx renders KPI cards, list of OPEN reports with Resolve + Block user actions — matches spec. Data cards showed 12 conversations / 35 messages / 7 open reports live.

success_rate.frontend: 100% of testable acceptance (image-picker native path skipped as spec allowed)

seed_data_creation: Test-only ephemeral users registered via /api/auth/register (chat2_buyer_*, chat2_agent_*, chat2_outsider_*) and one property inserted via Motor into amass_db.properties (title 'Phase2 Chat Duplex', Lekki Phase 1, verified=true, agent_id linked to chat2_agent). All prefixed accordingly, safe to leave — collection is dev DB.
